q: What is the harness identity outcome?
options: Record name/version/capabilities for every run and report them in status
a: Record name/version/capabilities for every run and report them in status

q: How is the tick harness signalled?
options: A field in the Stop payload only

q: How is the CLEO review freeze handled?
options: Work in a worktree and stop at the PR/release gate
a: Work in a worktree and stop at the PR/release gate until review-release approves
